summary: Backend auth and CRUD were exercised; parser topics and Expo web account persistence failed. Sign-in screen renders, but authenticated UI flows could not proceed.

minor.issue: Input 'Biology 2026-06-12: cells, genetics' returns first topic ': cells' instead of 'cells'.

integration_issues.issue: Registration response is followed by 'ExpoSecureStore.default.setValueWithKeyAsync is not a function'; token is not persisted and dashboard never loads.

action_items: Fix Expo web-compatible session persistence or provide a web fallback around SecureStore before retesting authenticated UI.
Fix schedule parser to strip the optional colon from captured topic text, then rerun API regression.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the requested protected configuration specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL; confirm the intended variable and keep it consistent.
Auth and all dependent dashboard flows are blocked on web by SecureStore API incompatibility.
Focus timer completion does not log a focus session to /api/focus/log, so analytics/study-time logging is not integrated.

success_rate.backend: 0% (1 regression test failed; auth/core CRUD passed until parser assertion)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ registration and related test records through the public API; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials file is empty; use unique example.com registration. First UI sign-in attempt correctly showed invalid credentials. Account creation reached API but failed on SecureStore web persistence.
rca_of_issue: Parser regex group 3 includes the delimiter colon because the colon is matched by the trailing optional separator pattern. Web auth calls SecureStore.setItemAsync, which maps to an unavailable setValueWithKeyAsync implementation in this preview; registration likely succeeds server-side, but client throws before setting token/state.
